Interface EMFCrossReferenceSetter.SelfReferencePolicy

Enclosing class:
EMFCrossReferenceSetter
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface EMFCrossReferenceSetter.SelfReferencePolicy
Functional interface for determining whether direct self-references are allowed.

This policy concerns only references where the owner and candidate are the same EObject (cycles of length one). It does not detect or prevent longer cycles among non-containment references.

Author:
Lorenzo Bettini
